texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: 1. Purpose and Principles
texts.text: 1. Purpose and Principles

texts.label: text
texts.orig: This document explains who may approve an expense claim at Nexora Technologies Ltd., how long approval should take, and when an approver may allow spending that goes beyond the Travel and Expense  Reimbursement  Policy  (NX-FIN-POL-012)  or  the  Meal  and  Hotel  Spending  Limits (NX-FIN-POL-013). It also lists every exception the Company recognises, so that employees know what to ask for and approvers know what they can grant.
texts.text: This document explains who may approve an expense claim at Nexora Technologies Ltd., how long approval should take, and when an approver may allow spending that goes beyond the Travel and Expense  Reimbursement  Policy  (NX-FIN-POL-012)  or  the  Meal  and  Hotel  Spending  Limits (NX-FIN-POL-013). It also lists every exception the Company recognises, so that employees know what to ask for and approvers know what they can grant.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Four principles guide the process. Approval is proportionate: low-value claims are approved quickly by the reporting manager, and higher-value claims face more scrutiny. Approval is independent: no one  approves  their  own  expenses  or  those  of  a  person  who  approves  theirs.  Exceptions  are  the exception: they are allowed when there is a genuine business or safety reason, they are documented, and  they  are  tracked.  Decisions  are  explained:  every  rejection  or  return  states  the  reason  in  the Expense Portal.
texts.text: Four principles guide the process. Approval is proportionate: low-value claims are approved quickly by the reporting manager, and higher-value claims face more scrutiny. Approval is independent: no one  approves  their  own  expenses  or  those  of  a  person  who  approves  theirs.  Exceptions  are  the exception: they are allowed when there is a genuine business or safety reason, they are documented, and  they  are  tracked.  Decisions  are  explained:  every  rejection  or  return  states  the  reason  in  the Expense Portal.

texts.text: 2. Approval Authority Matrix

texts.label: text
texts.orig: The approval level depends on the total value of the claim, which is the sum of all items in it. The first approver is always the employee's reporting manager recorded in the HR system.
texts.text: The approval level depends on the total value of the claim, which is the sum of all items in it. The first approver is always the employee's reporting manager recorded in the HR system.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Claims raised by managers are approved by their own manager. Claims raised by department heads are approved by the CFO. Claims raised by the CFO are approved by the CEO. Claims by the CEO are approved by the Chair of the Audit Committee.
texts.text: Claims raised by managers are approved by their own manager. Claims raised by department heads are approved by the CFO. Claims raised by the CFO are approved by the CEO. Claims by the CEO are approved by the Chair of the Audit Committee.

texts.orig: 4. Delegation and Absence
texts.text: 4. Delegation and Absence

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Approvers who will  be  absent  for  more  than  2  working  days  must  set  a  delegate  in  the  Expense Portal. The delegate must be at the same grade or higher and in the same reporting line. A delegate cannot approve a claim from a person who reports to them if there is a conflict of interest, and cannot approve their own claim.

The delegate must be at the same grade or higher and in the same reporting line. A delegate cannot approve a claim from a person who reports to them if there is a conflict of interest, and cannot approve their own claim.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Delegation is limited to 30 days. Longer absence needs HR approval.
texts.text: Delegation is limited to 30 days. Longer absence needs HR approval.

texts.label: list_item

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · A delegate cannot grant exceptions unless the delegation says so in writing, and only within the approver's own exception authority.
texts.text: A delegate cannot grant exceptions unless the delegation says so in writing, and only within the approver's own exception authority.

texts.orig: 5. Segregation of Duties and Conflicts of Interest
texts.text: 5. Segregation of Duties and Conflicts of Interest

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Good control depends on keeping the person who spends separate from the person who approves and the person who pays. The following rules apply to all claims.
texts.text: Good control depends on keeping the person who spends separate from the person who approves and the person who pays. The following rules apply to all claims.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · No employee may approve a claim in which they are a beneficiary, including claims for trips taken together with the approver, unless the approver's own claim is approved by a higher level.
texts.text: No employee may approve a claim in which they are a beneficiary, including claims for trips taken together with the approver, unless the approver's own claim is approved by a higher level.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Accounts Payable staff cannot create or approve claims in the portal.
texts.text: Accounts Payable staff cannot create or approve claims in the portal.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · An employee cannot approve the claims of a person who approves their own.
texts.text: An employee cannot approve the claims of a person who approves their own.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Family members and close relationships must be disclosed to HR. Claims between related persons are routed to the next level of approver.
texts.text: Family members and close relationships must be disclosed to HR. Claims between related persons are routed to the next level of approver.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Approvers must not accept gifts or favours from employees whose claims they approve.
texts.text: Approvers must not accept gifts or favours from employees whose claims they approve.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: 7. Exception Framework
texts.text: 7. Exception Framework

texts.label: text
texts.orig: An exception allows the Company to pay an expense that would otherwise be refused. It is not a right, and not every request is accepted. The framework has five rules.
texts.text: An exception allows the Company to pay an expense that would otherwise be refused. It is not a right, and not every request is accepted. The framework has five rules.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · An exception must match one of the codes in the catalogue. Requests that do not fit a code are referred to the Finance Controller as one-off cases.
texts.text: An exception must match one of the codes in the catalogue. Requests that do not fit a code are referred to the Finance Controller as one-off cases.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · The employee selects the code, writes a justification of at least two sentences and attaches evidence.
texts.text: The employee selects the code, writes a justification of at least two sentences and attaches evidence.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · The approver within the authority table above decides. They may approve in full, approve in part or reject.
texts.text: The approver within the authority table above decides. They may approve in full, approve in part or reject.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Every exception is recorded in the portal with the code, approver, amount and date, and is reported monthly.
texts.text: Every exception is recorded in the portal with the code, approver, amount and date, and is reported monthly.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · An employee with more than three exceptions in a quarter is reviewed by the Finance Controller.
texts.text: An employee with more than three exceptions in a quarter is reviewed by the Finance Controller.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Approving an exception does not change the policy limit for others, and it creates no precedent. Each case is judged on its own facts.
texts.text: Approving an exception does not change the policy limit for others, and it creates no precedent. Each case is judged on its own facts.

texts.orig: 11. Fraud Indicators and Investigation
texts.text: 11. Fraud Indicators and Investigation

texts.label: text
texts.orig: Finance and Internal Audit use the following indicators to identify claims that need closer review. An indicator is not proof of wrongdoing, and may have an innocent explanation.
texts.text: Finance and Internal Audit use the following indicators to identify claims that need closer review. An indicator is not proof of wrongdoing, and may have an innocent explanation.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Receipts with the same serial number or vendor details used in more than one claim.
texts.text: Receipts with the same serial number or vendor details used in more than one claim.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Hotel stays or flights that overlap with leave or a period when the employee was at another location.
texts.text: Hotel stays or flights that overlap with leave or a period when the employee was at another location.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Many items just below a receipt or approval threshold.
texts.text: Many items just below a receipt or approval threshold.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Round-number amounts in several categories.
texts.text: Round-number amounts in several categories.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Receipts that show alcohol, personal items or locations unrelated to the trip.
texts.text: Receipts that show alcohol, personal items or locations unrelated to the trip.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · High-value claims often approved by the same approver on the same day.
texts.text: High-value claims often approved by the same approver on the same day.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Sequential receipts for different days from the same vendor.
texts.text: Sequential receipts for different days from the same vendor.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Claims for personal vehicles with distances that do not match the route.
texts.text: Claims for personal vehicles with distances that do not match the route.

texts.label: list_item
texts.orig: · Frequent last-minute cancellations followed by new bookings.
texts.text: Frequent last-minute cancellations followed by new bookings.

texts.label: text
texts.orig: When an indicator is found, Finance contacts the employee and the approver for an explanation. If the explanation is not satisfactory, Internal Audit opens an investigation. The employee has the right to explain, and any disciplinary action is handled by HR under the Code of Conduct. Where a loss is confirmed, the amount is recovered, normally through salary after notice, and may be accompanied by further action.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: 13.1 Hotel over the cap in Hyderabad
texts.text: 13.1 Hotel over the cap in Hyderabad

texts.label: text
texts.orig: An L3 employee books a hotel at INR 8,200 per night for 2 nights in Hyderabad (Tier 1 cap INR 7,000). The excess is INR 2,400. The employee cites EX-02 with screenshots showing no inventory at the cap rate. Because the excess is between INR 2,001 and INR 10,000, the department head grants it and the claim proceeds.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: 14. Frequently Asked Questions
texts.text: 14. Frequently Asked Questions

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Q: Can my manager approve my hotel above the cap?
texts.text: Q: Can my manager approve my hotel above the cap?

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A: Only if the total excess on the claim is up to INR 2,000. Above that, the department head or higher must approve.
texts.text: A: Only if the total excess on the claim is up to INR 2,000. Above that, the department head or higher must approve.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Q: Can I submit the exception after the claim?
texts.text: Q: Can I submit the exception after the claim?

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A: Select the code and justification while submitting the claim. Adding it later requires the claim to be returned.
texts.text: A: Select the code and justification while submitting the claim. Adding it later requires the claim to be returned.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Q: How do I know the status of my claim?
texts.text: Q: How do I know the status of my claim?

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A: The Expense Portal shows each stage with the date and the person handling it.
texts.text: A: The Expense Portal shows each stage with the date and the person handling it.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Q: What if two approvers disagree?
texts.text: Q: What if two approvers disagree?

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A: The more senior approver decides.
texts.text: A: The more senior approver decides.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Q: Can an exception be approved by email?
texts.text: Q: Can an exception be approved by email?

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A: Pre-approvals can be by email, but the exception decision is recorded in the portal.
texts.text: A: Pre-approvals can be by email, but the exception decision is recorded in the portal.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Q: What if my manager is also the department head?
texts.text: Q: What if my manager is also the department head?

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A: Then one approval counts for both levels, but the Finance Controller still checks the claim.
texts.text: A: Then one approval counts for both levels, but the Finance Controller still checks the claim.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Q: Can Finance override an approver?
texts.text: Q: Can Finance override an approver?

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A: Finance can return or reject a claim that breaks policy, even if a manager has approved it.
texts.text: A: Finance can return or reject a claim that breaks policy, even if a manager has approved it.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Q: Are the limits for exceptions per claim or per quarter?
texts.text: Q: Are the limits for exceptions per claim or per quarter?

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A: They apply to each claim. The number of exceptions per employee per quarter is monitored.
texts.text: A: They apply to each claim. The number of exceptions per employee per quarter is monitored.

texts.label: section_header
texts.orig: Q: Do exceptions apply to contractors?
texts.text: Q: Do exceptions apply to contractors?

texts.label: text
texts.orig: A: Only if the contract allows reimbursement; otherwise no.
texts.text: A: Only if the contract allows reimbursement; otherwise no.
